# SaaSier Inc

> SaaSier Inc is a women-owned portfolio company building focused software businesses in developer tooling, vertical AI, and shared SaaS platform infrastructure.

SaaSier Inc is a woman-owned holding company, wholly owned by Macon Wright, founded in November 2025 and based in Franklin, Indiana (28 E 200 N, Franklin, IN 46131). SAM.gov UEI: Q53XABAMNXD5. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/saasierinc

## About

- [About SaaSier Inc](https://saasierinc.com/about.html): How SaaSier Inc builds focused software companies with a shared operating platform, plus leadership.
- [Capability Statement](https://saasierinc.com/capability-statement.html): Woman-owned Indiana S-corporation providing business operations consulting and applied AI services through SaaSy Solutions LLC; federal registration details.
- [Press & Media Kit](https://saasierinc.com/press.html): Logos, press releases, company facts, and media contact.
- [Investor Overview](https://saasierinc.com/investor-page.html): Portfolio structure, shared platform advantages, and current execution priorities.

## Portfolio

- [SaaSy Solutions LLC](https://saasysolutionsllc.com): The consulting and implementation arm for commercial teams and government-ready buyers, backed by the HelloSaaSy.ai platform. Operating subsidiary of SaaSier Inc.
- [Hello SaaSy](https://hellosaasy.ai): The AI back-office platform owned by SaaSy Solutions LLC: CRM, payroll, and compliance for service businesses. In open beta.
- [Hive Minded AI](https://hiveminded.ai): An intelligent operating system for modern beekeeping operations, from colony health to business outcomes.
- [MockForge](https://mockforge.dev): Service virtualization across modern protocols with realistic behavior simulation for development, QA, and integration teams.
- [CodeDig](https://codedig.ai): Live PR risk and blast-radius analysis for GitHub and GitLab. CodeDig is planned as its own company once the entity is set up.
